_doc: Answers the times-for-the-times blog got wrong where the grid alone could not say which fix is right, settled by reading the clue's wordplay. Keyed by post_id, then "<number> <direction>". tools/times_grids.py applies these before rebuilding the grid and records each as a correction.

17 across.wordplay: SWEEPS (cleans up) + TAKE (win); the blog gave SWEEPS

anagram of MERRY E NUNS; the blog typed NURSEYMEN
